protocol: Read-only `dumpsys window` (mCurrentFocus) + `dumpsys power` (mWakefulness / Display Power) before every input burst; two screencaps >= 20 s apart before the first input of each iteration — identical bytes means nobody is holding the phone (iter 1: 20:55:04 / 20:55:29 identical; iter 2: 21:25:20 / 21:25:52 identical). Two frames that caught the launcher (after a back-key overshoot) were deleted immediately and never left the scratchpad.
